Class JSONUtils.MappingField

public class JSONUtils.MappingField

Configuration class for mapping between JSON paths and Salesforce SObject fields. Defines transformation rules, validation logic, and default values for JSON-to-SObject conversions. Supports both mapped values (from JSON) and fixed values (hardcoded).

Since:

Constructs a MappingField with complete configuration for JSON-to-SObject mapping.

Parameters:
    mTag – JSON path to the source value (e.g., "customer/email").
    mFieldTag – SObject field path, may include relationships (e.g., "Contact.Email").
    mSObjectType – The SObject type for this mapping.
    mField – The specific SObject field to populate.
    mIsExternalId – Whether to capture this value as the external ID.
    mIsFixedValue – Whether to use a fixed value instead of JSON.
    mFixedValue – The fixed value to use when isFixedValue is true.
    mDefaultValue – Default value when JSON field is null/blank.
    mNullWhen – Condition for setting null ('omitted' or 'null').
    mMultiplyBy – Scaling factor for numeric values.
    mDateFormat – Date/datetime format pattern.
    mUsePrefix – Whether to prepend external ID prefix.
    mCapitalize – Whether to capitalize the value.
    mXRefType – Cross-reference lookup type identifier.
    mValidationType – Validation lookup type identifier.
